style: Somber instrumental music for an ancient glass machine in an abandoned hall at the edge of space. Sparse felt piano and muted glass bells repeat a sad minor phrase over a cold analog synthesizer pad and a deep sustained cello. Slow tape echoes, vast dark reverberation, isolated metallic creaks and a very quiet low heartbeat. Intimate, desolate and ominous, suspended and unresolved. No drums. Purely instrumental. Am, 108 BPM.
